text: うふふ　がんばってる　おかおが　すてきよ

structure.jp: がんばってる　おかおが　すてきよ
structure.en: your face when you're trying hard is lovely

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. てる is the shortened spoken form. がんばってる = 'is trying hard'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: がんばってる　おかお
patterns.explanation: A verb put right in front of a thing describes that thing. がんばってる　おかお = 'the face of someone trying hard'.
